privacyPolicy: Aggregate-only measurement. No campaign identities, character names, private choices, comments, or draft payloads may be captured or retained by any onboarding metric.

criteria.statement: A new player completing the default Level 1 slot reaches a fully valid Trainer preview (zero blocking issues) without facilitator rescue.
criteria.target: median <= 20 minutes, p90 <= 40 minutes across acceptance runs
criteria.measurement: acceptance journey timing (manual + scripted fixtures), aggregate durations only

criteria.statement: The default Level 1 + one starter path presents a bounded number of required decisions with one visually primary decision at a time.
criteria.target: <= 30 required decisions; every additional screen is optional depth, not a mandatory detour
criteria.measurement: static decision-graph count from the builder state machine fixture

criteria.statement: Every blocking issue names its owning decision and one activation lands the user on an operable control for it.
criteria.target: 100% of issue links land on the owning decision; recovery requires <= 2 navigations
criteria.measurement: automated issue-link traversal across failure fixtures

criteria.statement: Reload, another device, or server restart restores the draft to the exact current decision with no lost accepted state.
A GM reviews a default submission in one workspace without opening raw sheets or comparing JSON.
criteria.target: median <= 10 minutes for the default fixture; zero raw-ID or JSON steps
criteria.measurement: acceptance journey timing + workflow step audit

criteria.statement: Approval either creates the entire package or nothing; exact retry returns the original result.
criteria.target: 0 partial packages, 0 duplicates across all failure-injection fixtures

criteria.statement: From approval, a ready player reaches an eligible encounter and performs a legal first action without manual relinking.
criteria.target: <= 5 minutes GM+player combined in golden journeys; zero manual link/repair steps

criteria.statement: Keyboard-only, screen-reader, 200% zoom, 320px reflow, touch targets, and reduced motion pass on all builder, review, and completion surfaces.
criteria.target: zero serious/critical Axe violations; 100% keyboard script completion; 44x44 CSS px primary targets

criteria.statement: Large starter pools and feature catalogs stay responsive.
criteria.target: choice list render/filter p95 <= 100ms on benchmark fixtures; validation recompute p95 <= 250ms

criteria.statement: No unauthorized role ever receives another profile's draft choices, comments, or review detail.
